name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery Gutenberg bulk-order workflow with WooCommerce and ASE Supplier Sync compatibility.
changelog:
1.1.4

  • WooCommerce Regular Price is now the authoritative customer-facing 1+ price.
  • Legacy 1: ASBO matrix entries are ignored; all established bulk tiers above 1 remain unchanged.
  • Total Saved uses Woo Regular Price as its normal-price baseline.
  • ASBO does not read or expose unit_buy_price, supplier price_breaks, MAP, MSRP, suggested retail, or list prices.
  • Missing Woo Regular Price now fails clearly and directs admins to Supplier Sync Quick Repair.
  • Removed the legacy blank-price purchasability bypass.
